comment: Good luck. He made an already tough class even tougher than it needed to be. No help at all on whathow to study for testsexams and gave closed-book, TIMED HOMEWORK which is very difficult. If attendance wasn't mandatory in the sense you'd get dropped if you skip, I wouldn't attend his class. He doesn't really teach, just reads PowerPoints slides.

So easy, loved how I haven;t done any hw until now except for 2 assignments.....online. All tests are multiple choice and gives a good amount of time before tests. Take this class trust me, you might have to study extra on your own cause he's not that clear but genuinely wants to help if things are unclear. Plus he has a sense of humor.

BDick is the man! Very easy, I studied an average of probably three hours per test and there is virtually no homework. He doesn't appear to know what he's talking about sometimes so you do need to pay attention in class, nice grading scale, easy A, effortless B, cool guy
Nice guy. Easy teacher if you are good at multiple choice. Do the homework, pay attention in class even though he can be boring. He wants you to do well. I would take him if you can.
very boring. reads off slides from the textbook the whole class but doesn't teach anything. tests are online and aren't too bad.
